articles.title: Windows SignDrop 0-Day Exploit Lets Attackers Gain SYSTEM Privileges Through CLFS Protection
articles.summary:
A public exploit called SignDrop targets a Windows security feature meant to stop attacks on the Common Log File System (CLFS). It claims to turn a normal user account into a SYSTEM account, the highest level of control on Windows. The flaw has no CVE number and no patch as of November 11, 2026. Microsoft […]

articles.title: eMudhra Revokes 8 More Certificate Authorities Following Major SSL Private Key Security Failure
articles.summary:
eMudhra has revoked eight additional intermediate certificate authorities (CAs) after conducting a thorough review of the key issue that led to its October security failure. The new group did not have weak keys, but eMudhra could not prove the keys were handled the way its own rules require. The company has now pulled 16 intermediate […]

articles.title: Git Fixes 6 Security Vulnerabilities Allowing Hackers to Execute Malicious Code Through Cloned Repositories
articles.summary:

The other five involve unsafe file writes and memory corruption in merges and patches. Git announced the fixes on November 10, 2026. The patches arrive in Git 2.56.1. They are also backported to 2.55.1, 2.54.1, […]
